```{r setup, include=FALSE}
setwd(normalizePath(file.path(getwd(), "..")))
source("report/results.R")
```

## Problem and goal
- Unusual logins (odd hours, bursts, spikes) are worth reviewing
- Goal: transparent statistical rules, not a black box
- All data synthetic; a flag means "unusual", not "attack"

## Workflow
![](figures/architecture.png)

## Synthetic data
- `r nrow(ev)` events, 25 users, 60 days (seed 42)
- 30-day baseline (clean) + 30-day evaluation (`r sum(truth)` injected anomalies)
- Normal noise: random-hour logins, mistyped-password streaks

## Rule 1: login-hour rarity
- Smoothed per-user hour probabilities, circular kernel (23:00 ~ 00:00)
- Flag if P(hour) < r/24

## Rule 2 and 3: frequency and bursts
- z = (k - mean)/max(sd, 1), capped at 10
- Burst: failures in trailing 10 minutes
- Score = max of normalised components; flag if >= 1

## Threshold profiles
- relaxed (r 0.10, z 3.5, b 6), balanced (0.20, 3.0, 4), strict (0.30, 2.5, 3)

## Results
```{r}
knitr::kable(fmt3(res[, c("profile", "TP", "FP", "TN", "FN", "precision", "recall", "fpr")]))
```

## Threshold comparison
![](figures/threshold_comparison.png)

## Limitations
- Simulated data; self-injected anomalies
- Normal approximation for counts; stable-habit assumption
- Subtle anomalies are missed; results are not real-world evidence

## Testing and app
- 100 automated expectations, all passing
- Shiny app: Overview, Login Explorer, Threshold Lab, Insights
